answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 7822 Country: United Kingdom Title: Q) A Orphan Child who is not mature has money in his account,is it permissible to give Zakaat to the Orphana child? Question: Assalamualaykum Q) A Orphan Child who is not mature has money in his account,is it permissible to give Zakaat to the Orphana child? Answer ID: 7822 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1207/1051=L /1429) It is right to give a child zakah if he does not own an amount equal to Nisab, Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
